issues.title: Problem in translations with :type added, created, updated
Currency conversion is not applied when company currency matches account currency
Enabling, disabling or bulk editing an item, contact or user deletes its taxes, contact persons or picture
Accounts, customers and vendors used by a recurring template can be deleted
Item taxes of invoices and bills created from recurring templates keep the template's type

latest_release.body:
### Added

- Added accrued and outstanding status groups to documents ([#3425](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3425))

### Changed

- Replace deprecated node-sass with dart-sass ([#3393](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3393))
- Enable TLS verification for Site API requests ([#3401](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3401))

### Fixed

- Forms send a multipart part with an empty field name (name=""), rejected by strict parsers/WAFs with HTTP 400 ([#3412](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/issues/3412))
- Fixed percentage total discount taking too little from lines with inclusive tax ([#3415](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3415))
- Fixed two taxes of the same kind on one line being charged twice ([#3417](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3417))
- Fixed reconciled transfers being edited or deleted ([#3419](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3419))
- Fixed bulk edit changing the discount and categories of documents ([#3421](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3421))
- Fixed installer blaming the database details when the PDO driver is missing ([#3422](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3422))
- Fixed bulk edit of transactions changing their currency and rate ([#3423](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3423))
- Fixed draft documents counted as open and overdue on the contact page ([#3424](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3424))
- Fix invoice logo size handling and add validation for logo dimensions ([#3427](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3427))
- Fix queue workers keeping the in-memory model cache from job to job ([#3428](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3428))
